dependency_decisions.rationale: Establishes the idempotent bootstrap/template baseline and remains the only root prerequisite.
Adds shared runner metadata, offload pointers, and structured logs immediately after bootstrap so downstream gates inherit observability.
Builds deterministic Plan->Patch->Test->Report and authority/risk gates on top of baseline templates and telemetry infra.
Applies single-worktree and drift hardening only after bootstrap, telemetry, and orchestration semantics are in place.
Resume checkpoints, scoped autofix, and fail-closed commit gate depend on stable orchestration plus drift-safe recovery and evidence logs.
Role separation and mandatory Plan Reviewer gate layer on deterministic execution core; no extra prerequisite is required by the alignment contract.
Anti-hardcode policy and synthetic smoke validation run after deterministic orchestration and role-gated execution are established.
Incremental PRD reconciliation and learning-loop proposals are sequenced last, after bootstrap baseline plus drift-hardened resume/commit reliability.
